content.comment_body: Hello, in both [version_no] there appears to be support for an astronomic clock. However, when accessing the parameter settings, there is no option to set an "offset" even though it is mentioned in the help documentation. Is this potentially a software issue or something else?
That seems to be the case. This relates to adjusting sunrise and sunset times. Most likely, it's a limitation of your current software.
When I use [product_name] [version_no], I can't find the offset adjustment. Apparently, the offset feature is new and available only in the newer [software_name] versions.
The manual for [article_no] states that this is a new feature specifically for [version_no], not for the earlier version.
A new question from [user_name] was moved to a dedicated thread with the topic about software for backing up older [product_name] devices. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users found that the 'offset' parameter for the astronomic clock, while mentioned in documentation, is missing from the settings in both stated versions. Further discussion clarified that the offset adjustment is not available in certain software versions and is exclusive to the newer hardware and software releases, leading to user confusion due to outdated or unclear documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to locate and adjust the offset option for the astronomic clock in both product versions, as described in the help materials.
